newsitem.title: USA: Tennessee plans $60.8 million GO bonds in FY 1998.
newsitem.headline: Tennessee plans $60.8 million GO bonds in FY 1998.

text.p: Tennessee plans to issue $60.8 million of general obligation bonds during the fiscal year that began July 1 for projects approved in the spring legislative session, a state official said.

The largest, a $24.9 million issue, will fund construction of a 140,000-square-foot headquarters building for the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation. Bureau offices are now scattered in six buildings across the city.
"There is no date for the sale of the bonds yet. The project is in the design phase right now," Mary Margaret Collier, assistant difector for the state's Division of Bond Finance, said Tuesday.
Construction is expected to begin in May or June. Collier said the state typically issues notes as needed during construction, then sells bonds for the project when it nears completion.
Other GO bond issues planned during the year are:
--$15 million for construction projects at East Tennessee State University in Johnson City and Tennessee State University in Nashville.
--$4.9 million for maintenance at other Tennessee Board of Regents schools.
--$4.8 million for maintenance of schols in the University of Tennessee system.
--$11 million for maintenance of facilities statewide.
